tweets.text: You can get access to Silico here: https://t.co/gvZ4PH1A0u

We finally have a product that helps with frontier AI research.

Frontier LLMs are a) nerfed at AI research b) lack immediate GPU availability and c) lack access to the right skills and research material.

"Teach me how vision models see"

Goodfire Silico takes a vision transformer (ViT), loads ImageNet images, and for each head, visualizes the 196x196 matrix by creating animated arcs across patches. 

Haven't found another model or product that can do this level of comprehensive AI research, much less oneshot it.

Wow. Airtable, founded in 2012 and  once valued at $11.7B, is getting acquired by Bending Spoons, founded 2013, at 2.7x ARR.

A once hot startup; now an unfortunate victim of the SaaS bust. It raised $1.4B only to be sold for $1.285B EV ($2.25B equity value), just clearing its preference stack.

That implies common and early holders split the remaining ~$850M, a ~10x haircut from peak.
